welcome.title: Introduction
welcome.text: Hi, I'm Kapil Rana, I'm a Senior Manager and SDE III at Airtel Payments Bank. I walk you through this portfolio the way I would in an interview: impact first, then the technologies.

positioning.title: What I do
positioning.text: I have {years} years of full-stack experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and React Native. I led Internet Banking for about a million users a day and I manage a team of 4. I ship products across 5 companies mostly in fintech, commerce, advertising, marketing.

impact.title: Impact
impact.text: I organize each role by business impact and technical impact. First, what changed for users and revenue, then the stack that made it possible. Let's start with Airtel, my current role.

airtel.title: Airtel Payments Bank
airtel.text: At Airtel, I own the internet banking experience under RBI compliance. We improved page speed with Next.js server-side rendering, Cloudflare caching and Core Web Vitals. We reduced bot abuse with Cloudflare security and Google reCAPTCHA. I own a NestJS backend also on Node.js in front of that service. I run a Kong gateway for load balancing with plugins for CORS, JWT and rate limiting. On the content side, Next.js and Prismic sits on a Node.js Prismic service I built. In production, I use Kibana and Grafana for logging and monitoring.

dotpe.title: DotPe
dotpe.text: Before Airtel, I was a software engineer II at DotPe. From 2020 to 2025, I led 4 engineers on merchant billing, invoicing, inventory, GST and analytics. Food ordering reached 50,000 daily users and over a crore a day. I built the React Native waiter app and owned the Node.js backend behind it. APIs, order sync and offline-ready flows. We also shipped real-time chat with Socket.io and Firebase.

tyroo.title: Tyroo
tyroo.text: At Tyroo, I built the video template UI in React, Redux and Ant Design. I also owned the video generation backend, a Node.js service and a Lottie service that rendered marketing videos at scale.

meddo.title: Meddo Health
meddo.text: At Meddo Health, I built the React Native patient app, the doctor app plus the web product. Those covered video consults, chats, EMR and lab bookings. I also wrote Node.js APIs for Google Auth, bulk upload and media.

lotto.title: Skill and Lotto
lotto.text: My first role was at Skill and Lotto. I built an online platform and back-office tools with JavaScript, jQuery, PHP and Bootstrap.

about.title: How I work
about.text: Day to day, I run the team in Jira, planning, priorities and delivery. I keep a high bar on React, TypeScript, quality. I own Node.js and NestJS services and I work with other engineers on API contracts and backend designing. After we ship, I stay in logs and dashboards using Kibana, Grafana and Kong.

exp-airtel.title: Airtel — full story
exp-airtel.text: This is the full Airtel role. I lead four engineers, we ship Next.js with Prismic and NestJS backend and Kong for load balancing, JWT, CORS and rate limiting. Page speed comes from server-side rendering, Cloudflare caching and Web Vitals. I own this surface end-to-end, not just tickets.

exp-dotpe.title: DotPe — full story
exp-dotpe.text: DotPe is a multi-product chapter: billing, WhatsApp marketing, live chat, the React Native waiter app, the Node.js behind it. It was revenue-linked work, across web, mobile and backend.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: Skills are grouped into frontend, backend, mobile, DevOps and leadership. React and TypeScript and Node are the core. On the backend, I own NestJS and Node service for Prismic. The waiter app is built on React Native and the video generation tool is built on Node.js backend. On mobile, waiter app, patient app, doctor app is on React Native. Then Express, MongoDB, SQL, AWS, Docker, Kong, Kibana and Grafana.

education.title: Education
education.text: I completed B.Tech in Computer Science engineering at K.R. Mangalam University from 2014 to 2018. Since then, I have worked at product companies in Gurgaon.

close.text: That's the walkthrough. If you would like to talk, email or LinkedIn is the easiest, or you can contact me on my number. You can also download the PDF, restart this anytime from the avatar. Thank you.

finance.title: Finance
finance.blurb: Loan EMI, SIP wealth projection, and India GST — built for everyday money decisions.

common.disclaimer: Estimates only. Not financial advice. Actual figures may include fees, taxes, or a different compounding convention.

emi.title: EMI Calculator
emi.card: Monthly instalment, total interest, and a year-wise amortization schedule for home, car, and personal loans.
emi.lead: Work out the equated monthly instalment for a home loan, car loan, or personal loan. Change principal, interest rate, and tenure to see EMI, total interest, and a year-wise payoff schedule.
emi.how1: The reducing-balance formula used by most Indian lenders is EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1). P is the loan amount, r is the monthly rate (annual rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100), and n is the tenure in months. If the rate is 0%, EMI is simply principal ÷ months.
emi.how2: Each month, interest is charged on the outstanding principal. The rest of the EMI reduces the balance. That is why early years are interest-heavy and later years are principal-heavy — the table below the result shows that year by year.
emi.metaTitle: EMI Calculator — Monthly Loan EMI, Interest & Amortization | Kapil Rana
emi.metaDescription: Free EMI calculator for home, car, and personal loans in India. Get monthly EMI, total interest, total payment, and a year-wise amortization schedule.
emi.ogDescription: Calculate EMI, total interest, and amortization in your browser.

0.a: EMI (Equated Monthly Instalment) is the fixed amount you pay every month toward a loan. It includes both principal and interest.

1.a: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where P is the loan amount, r is the monthly interest rate, and n is the number of months.

2.q: Does a shorter tenure reduce interest?
2.a: Yes. A shorter tenure raises the monthly EMI but usually cuts total interest because the principal is repaid faster.

3.a: Yes. This online EMI calculator is free, runs in your browser, and does not store the numbers you enter.

sip.title: SIP Calculator
sip.card: Estimate the future value of a monthly systematic investment plan with expected returns.
sip.lead: Project the maturity value of a monthly systematic investment plan. Enter the instalment, expected annual return, and duration to see invested capital versus estimated gains.
sip.how1: This uses the standard beginning-of-period SIP formula: FV = M × [((1+i)^n − 1) / i] × (1+i). M is the monthly instalment, i is the monthly expected return, and n is the number of months. A 12% annual assumption becomes 1% per month.
sip.how2: The invested amount is simply instalment × months. Estimated returns are future value minus invested amount. Markets do not compound in a straight line — treat the chart as a planning range, not a promise.
sip.metaTitle: SIP Calculator — Mutual Fund SIP Returns & Maturity Value | Kapil Rana
sip.metaDescription: Free SIP calculator for India. Estimate invested amount, expected returns, and maturity value of a monthly systematic investment plan.
sip.ogDescription: Estimate SIP invested amount, returns, and future value.

0.a: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) invests a fixed amount at regular intervals — usually monthly — into a mutual fund.

1.a: Future value = M × [((1+i)^n − 1) / i] × (1+i), where M is the monthly investment, i is the monthly expected return, and n is the number of months.

2.a: No. The expected return is an assumption. Actual mutual-fund returns vary with markets.

3.q: SIP vs lump sum — which is better?
3.a: SIP spreads purchases over time and can reduce timing risk. A lump sum may earn more if invested just before a long uptrend. This calculator models a monthly SIP only.

gst.title: GST Calculator
gst.card: Add or remove GST at 5%, 12%, 18%, or 28%. Split CGST/SGST or apply IGST.
gst.lead: Add GST to a base price or extract tax from an inclusive amount. Use official slabs (0, 5, 12, 18, 28%) and split the tax as CGST + SGST or a single IGST line.
gst.how1: Exclusive GST: tax = amount × rate / 100, total = amount + tax. Inclusive GST: base = amount / (1 + rate/100), tax = amount − base. Intra-state supply splits tax 50/50 into CGST and SGST. Inter-state supply shows the same tax as IGST.
gst.how2: Common slabs in India are 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%. Some goods also attract compensation cess — this calculator does not add cess. Confirm the HSN/SAC rate before you issue or pay an invoice.
gst.metaTitle: GST Calculator — Add or Remove GST (CGST, SGST, IGST) | Kapil Rana
gst.metaDescription: Free India GST calculator. Add or remove 5%, 12%, 18%, or 28% GST. Split CGST/SGST for intra-state supply or apply IGST for inter-state.
gst.ogDescription: Add or remove Indian GST and split CGST/SGST or IGST.

0.a: Goods and Services Tax is India’s destination-based indirect tax. Most goods and services fall under 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, or 28%.

1.q: What is the difference between exclusive and inclusive GST?
1.a: Exclusive adds GST on top of a base price. Inclusive extracts GST from a price that already contains tax: base = amount / (1 + rate/100).

2.a: Intra-state supply splits GST equally into CGST and SGST. Inter-state supply uses a single IGST amount equal to the full GST.

3.q: Does this GST calculator file returns?
3.a: No. It only estimates tax on a given amount. Use it to check invoices — it is not a substitute for GST filing software or a tax advisor.
